sourceSentences: Shield of Daybreak resets Leona's basic attack timer.
Shield of Daybreak's attack does not put Leona's basic attack on cooldown. This effectively performs a second basic attack reset.
Leona will wait out Shield of Daybreak's wind-down before automatically attacking, anyway. The player must issue the next attack themselves to gain the full benefit of the second reset.
Neither the cast nor detonation of Eclipse interrupts any of Leona's previous orders or ongoing attack windups.
Her shield detonates after the duration, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies. If this hits an enemy, Leona's guard is extended for an additional 3 seconds.
She can cast any of her abilities during the dash.
Leona will not track the target if they change locations during her dash. She will only dash to their current location at the time the sword fizzled.
Spell shield will block the damage, and prevent Leona from dashing as the last champion struck by her sword.
Solar Flare's visual effects are only visible to enemies if they have sight of the area it was cast upon.
Allied champions' damaging attacks and abilities against a marked target will consume the mark to deal bonus magic damage.
